description: Weight sources: downloadable repositories or registered local model identities.

revision.description: Repository commit or registered local revision, when known.

subfolder.description: Repository subpath when weights are nested: a directory, or a single file when no directory has that name. In the spec's own weights or a component's it may name the rank, as in rank${GPUWORKS_NODE_RANK} (the older ${NODE_RANK} is an alias): each rank of a multi-node deployment then downloads and mounts only its own subfolder, and the block's weight_bytes is one rank's size.
